hero.eyebrow: Open Beta · For Greek Real Estate Agents

v1.text: In Greece, <accent>4 out of 10</accent> property deals fall apart because the two sides never connected.
v1.source: Source: Bank of Greece, Housing Market Report 2024

v2.text: Greek agents lose <accent>11 hours a week</accent> on admin that should not exist.
v2.source: Source: CEPI European Real Estate Agent Survey 2023

v3.text: Over <accent>60%</accent> of Greek brokers say finding the other side of a deal is their biggest challenge.
v3.source: Source: Hellenic Property Federation, Annual Market Survey 2024

v4.text: The average Greek property sits on the market <accent>30% longer</accent> than the EU average. The buyers exist. The connection does not.
v4.source: Source: Eurostat, Housing Price & Duration Index Q3 2024

hero.subtext: Oikion is where agents find the other side of their deals. Your clients, your listings, and a network of professionals across the country, all in one place.
hero.networkAlt: Network visualization showing agents connecting through matchmaking

problem.label: The Problem
problem.title: Greek real estate still runs on spreadsheets, phone calls, and luck.
problem.body: Agents spend more time chasing information than closing deals. The tools are scattered. The network is invisible. And good opportunities slip away every single day.

fragmentation.title: Four tools to close one deal.
fragmentation.body: Spreadsheets for mandates. WhatsApp for communication. Spitogatos and XE for search. Nothing talks to anything else, and every new deal means starting from zero.

network.title: The right agent exists. You just have no way to find them.
network.body: Every deal has two sides. Right now, the only way to find the other side is through personal contacts, cold calls, and pure chance. Deals fall apart simply because two people never crossed paths.

information.title: You are making big decisions with incomplete information.
information.body: What sold in the neighbourhood last month? What does demand actually look like right now? Which buyer fits which property? The data exists. It is just buried across ten different places.

solution.label: The Solution
solution.title: One place to run your business. One network to close your deals.
solution.subtitle: Oikion gives you your clients, your listings, and access to a nationwide agent network with built-in matchmaking. You focus on the work. We make sure the right people find each other.

network.title: Agent Network
network.body: Connect with verified agents across Greece. Build real professional relationships, share listings on your terms, and find the collaboration partner you have been looking for.

matchmaking.title: Smart Matchmaking
matchmaking.body: You add a seller mandate. Another agent across the country has the buyer. Our system finds the match and notifies you both. No cold calls. No guesswork.

alerts.title: Market Alerts
alerts.body: New listing matches your buyer? An agent in your network has a client who fits your property? You will know about it the moment it happens.

privacy.title: Your Data Stays Yours
privacy.body: Nothing is shared without your say. Bilateral sharing means both sides agree first. You decide who sees what, and you can change your mind at any time.

howItWorks.label: How It Works
howItWorks.title: Up and running in minutes. Not weeks.
howItWorks.subtitle: Four steps. That is genuinely all it takes to start finding matches.

profile.title: Set up your agency.
profile.body: Add your team, your areas of focus, and where you operate. The whole thing takes about five minutes.

listings.title: Bring in your listings.
listings.body: Import your properties and buyer mandates, or create them from scratch. Every entry you add starts working with the matchmaking engine right away.

match.title: Matches come to you.
match.body: Our system checks your mandates against the entire network, around the clock. When there is a fit, both agents get notified instantly.

close.title: Close it together.
close.body: Connect with the matched agent directly. Share documents, align on terms, and close the deal, all inside the platform.

team.label: The Team
team.title: Three people. One mission.
team.subtitle: We are not a corporation. We are three people who got tired of watching Greek agents work with broken tools, and decided to build something better.

member1.name: Stavros
member1.philosophy: The best software is the kind you do not notice. It just works, and you get on with your day.

member2.name: Alex
member2.philosophy: If the product is good, you do not need to oversell it. Just show people what it does.

member3.name: Nikos
member3.philosophy: I have sat on the other side of this screen. Every feature we build comes from a real problem I have lived through.

team.quote: We are not building software. We are building the tools that make good agents great.
